title: Day 11 — DC Motors, the H-Bridge, and PWM

slides.title: DC Motors, the H-Bridge, and PWM
slides.subtitle: ENGS 28 · Day 11 — In-Class

slides.title: Where we are
items: We have spent our time so far on the input side, on sensors and switches, and on displays. Today we turn to actuators.
Today we work out what sets a motor's speed, and then build the hardware that controls it.
You read about the two things a motor needs from us: a way to reverse the polarity of its voltage, which sets its direction, and a way to vary the average of that voltage, which sets its speed.
We will build both, and by the end of the class every one of us will have a motor running under a program that ramps its speed.
slides.presenterNote: ≈ 3 min with announcements. 110 minutes today. Hardware out: Nucleo, TB6612 breakout, TT motor, regulator board and wall adapter, AD2.
